en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Dukadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (6) 12.6.
Hetuduka, Piṭṭhiduka

Dependent on a state that is neither-rooted nor to be abandoned by insight … dependent on a state that is neither-rooted nor to be abandoned by cultivation … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is neither-rooted nor to be abandoned by non-cultivation.

Dependent on a state that is not a cause (nahetu) …pe… dependent on a state that is not a cause and has a root to be abandoned by insight (nadassanena pahātabbahetuka) …pe… dependent on a state that is not a cause and has a root to be abandoned neither by insight nor by cultivation (nanadassanena pahātabbahetuka) …pe… dependent on a state that is not a cause and has a root to be abandoned by cultivation (nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuka) …pe….
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and has a root to be abandoned neither by cultivation nor by insight (nanabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuka) …pe….

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor accompanied by initial application (*vitakka*) …pe… dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor without initial application (*avitakka*) …pe… dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor accompanied by sustained application (*vicāra*) …pe… dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor without sustained application (*avicāra*) …pe… dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor accompanied by rapture (*pīti*) …pe… dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor without rapture (*appītika*) …pe…

In dependence on a state that is not a cause and is not accompanied by rapture …pe… in dependence on a state that is not a cause and is not accompanied by non-rapture …pe… in dependence on a state that is not a cause and is not accompanied by pleasure …pe… in dependence on a state that is not a cause and is not accompanied by non-pleasure …pe… in dependence on a state that is not a cause and is not accompanied by equanimity …pe… in dependence on a state that is not a cause and is not accompanied by non-equanimity.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor of the sense sphere … dependent on a state that is neither a root nor of the fine-material sphere … dependent on a state that is neither a root nor of the immaterial sphere … dependent on a state that is neither a root nor of the non-percipient beings … dependent on a state that is neither a root nor of the supramundane … [and so forth] … dependent on a state that is neither a root nor of the supramundane.
... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither-cause nor fine-material-sphere ... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither-cause nor immaterial-sphere ... pe ...
dependent on a state that is neither-cause nor included [in the mundane] ... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither-cause nor not-included [in the mundane] ...
pe ... dependent on a state that is neither-cause nor leading-out ... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither-cause nor not-leading-out.
... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor determined ... pe ...
dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor undetermined ...
pe ... dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor surpassable ... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor unsurpassable ... pe ...
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor a refuge, a state that is neither a cause nor a refuge arises by way of the root condition. (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor an obstacle, a state that is neither a cause nor an obstacle arises by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor an obstacle, a state that is not a cause but is not an obstacle arises by way of the root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor an obstacle...
Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor an obstacle, states that are neither roots nor obstacles arise by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor an obstacle, a state that is neither a root nor an obstacle arises by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor an obstacle, a state that is a root but not an obstacle arises by way of the root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor an obstacle... [and so forth].
Dependent on a rootless non-afflictive state, there arise states that are neither rootless nor non-afflictive by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is both rootless and non-afflictive, and a state that is neither rootless nor non-afflictive, there arises a state that is rootless and non-afflictive by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both rootless and non-afflictive, and a state that is neither rootless nor non-afflictive, there arises a state that is neither rootless nor non-afflictive...

A state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor-obsession and a state that is neither-not-root nor-not-obsession, there arise states that are neither-root nor-obsession and states that are neither-not-root nor-not-obsession by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Nine [answers] for root. (Nine in all cases.)
